home.pitch: One detail, from very close. The picture slowly pulls back. Can you name it before the end?
home.failed: The game could not start. Check your connection and try again.

scoringHint.decay: The faster you find it, the more it pays: from 1000 down to 200 points.
scoringHint.fixed: The first to find it gets 1000 points, the second 800, the third 600, everyone after 500. Time does not count.

displayHint.phones: Everyone sees the picture on their own phone.
displayHint.bigscreen: The picture goes on a TV or a laptop. Phones are controllers: answers and bonuses.

home.bigScreenHint: This device shows the picture to everyone, and everyone plays from their phone. The first person to join picks the settings.
home.bigScreenOpen: Use this device as the screen

join.title: Join a game, {appName}
join.missing: This code does not match any game in progress. Check it with the person who invited you.
join.started: The game has already started: you come in on the next round.
join.firstIn: You open the game: you will pick the settings

lobby.inviteHint: Have this code scanned, or send the link.
lobby.qrAlt: QR code to join the game

lobby.waitingHost: The host starts the game when everyone is here.
lobby.startFailed: The game could not start. Try again.
lobby.screenOpen: Open this address on the TV or the laptop:
lobby.screenHere: Open the screen on this device

bonus.shieldUp: Shield up: it will stop the next attack.
bonus.noTarget: Nobody to aim at right now.

error.TARGET_INVALID: That player cannot be targeted. You keep your bonus.
error.BAD_PHASE: This bonus would be of no use right now. You keep it.
error.other: The bonus could not be played.

feed.stealPoints: {from} will take a share of {to}'s points

granted.streak: Bonus earned: {bonus} (3 correct answers in a row)
granted.catchup: Bonus earned: {bonus} (a hand for whoever is last)

play.title: Game in progress, {appName}
play.worthNote: points if you find it now
play.foundWaiting: Found. Waiting for the round to end.
play.locked: Wrong pick. You can try again in {seconds} s.

feedback.close: Almost. Check the spelling or give the full name.
feedback.rate_limited: Easy, one answer at a time.

play.nextRound: You play from the next round.
play.kicked: The host removed you from the game.
play.worthFixed: points for the next one to find it
play.frozen: Your input is frozen for a few seconds.
play.secondZoneAlt: Another part of the same picture
play.lookUp: The picture is on the big screen
play.screenGone: The big screen is disconnected. Open it again to see the picture.

end.title: Game over, your score
end.replayParty: Play again with the same players
end.waitingHost: The host can start another game.

screen.title: Big screen, {appName}
screen.orCode: or go to {host} and enter the code
screen.firstIsHost: The first person to join picks the settings and starts the game.
screen.hostStarts: {host} starts the game from their phone.
screen.phonesMode: This game shows the picture on the phones. The host can pick “On a big screen” in the settings.
screen.worthNote: points for whoever finds it now
screen.replayHint: {host} can start another game from their phone.
screen.full: Too many screens on this game
screen.closedHint: Everybody left, or nobody came. You can open another one on this screen.

account.title: Account, {appName}
account.heading: Account
account.pitch: You play without an account, and that will never change. An account is for one thing: finding your stats and your place in the ranking on all your devices.
account.passwordRule: At least {n} characters. A sentence does very well.
account.keepsHistory: What you already played on this device is kept and attached to your account.
account.logoutHint: When you sign out, this device becomes a guest’s again. Your history stays with your account.
account.changed: Password changed. Your other devices are signed out.
account.deleteHint: Your address, your password and your records are erased for good. Your games stay in other players’ history, under an anonymous name.

error.taken: An account already exists with this address. Sign in instead.
error.locked: Too many attempts. Try again in a moment.
error.weak: Invalid address, or password too short.
error.wrong: That is not your current password.
error.failed: That did not work. Check your connection and try again.

account.resetHint: Give the address of your account: you will get a link that lasts one hour.
account.resetSent: If an account exists with this address, a link was just sent to it. Check the spam folder too.
account.resetInvalid: This link is no longer valid. Ask for a new one.
account.resetDone: Password changed. You can sign in.

stats.title: My stats, {appName}
stats.heading: My stats
stats.of: Those of {nickname}, over every finished game.
stats.empty: Nothing to show yet: finish a game and come back.
stats.guestNudge: These stats live on this device. With an account you find them everywhere, and you enter the ranking.

rankings.title: Ranking, {appName}
rankings.heading: Ranking
rankings.rule: Points scored in games with other people, by players who have an account.
rankings.empty: Nobody in the ranking for this period. First place is up for grabs.
rankings.needAccount: You need an account to be in it: without one, a device is not somebody.

loginError.locked: Too many attempts. Try again in a quarter of an hour.
loginError.failed: Signing in failed. Check that the server is running.

admin.failed: That did not work. Reload the page and try again.
admin.formError: A field is not valid (the source address must start with https://).
admin.publicMatchSafe: May be used in public games between strangers
admin.restrictedHint: Real people and fictional characters: this pack stays off the landing page, previews, search engines and anything paid.

visibilityHint.PRIVATE: Nobody plays with this pack for now.
visibilityHint.PENDING_REVIEW: A player submitted this pack: it is waiting for your review.
visibilityHint.PUBLIC: Its published cards come up in games.
visibilityHint.DISABLED: Taken out of the game. Running games stop seeing it from their next round.

admin.isPersonLong: It is a person: look for the face and propose zoom points
admin.publishable: Nothing is missing: the card can be published.
admin.deleteConfirm: Delete this card, its image and its crops? This cannot be undone.

blocker.RIGHTS_NOT_CONFIRMED: The right to use the image was not confirmed.
blocker.CREDIT_MISSING: It needs a credit: author and licence. No credit, no publication.
blocker.ANSWER_FR_MISSING: The answer in French is missing.
blocker.ANSWER_EN_MISSING: The answer in English is missing.
blocker.TOO_FEW_POINTS: It needs at least two zoom points.
blocker.CROPS_MISSING: Some crops are not ready: save the points again.

admin.imageRules: JPEG, PNG or WebP, {mb} MB at most, at least {min} px on each side. EXIF data (GPS, camera) is removed, and the original stays private.
admin.rights: I confirm that I have the right to use this image, and that I know its author and licence.

uploadError.UNSUPPORTED_TYPE: This file is not a JPEG, PNG or WebP image.
uploadError.UNREADABLE: The image cannot be read, or is damaged.
uploadError.TOO_SMALL: The image is too small: the close-up would be a blur.
uploadError.RIGHTS_NOT_CONFIRMED: Tick the box: the right to use the image must be confirmed.
uploadError.FAILED: Processing failed on our side. Upload the image again.
uploadError.PROCESSING: This card is already being processed.

admin.working: The server is working on the image… this page updates by itself.
admin.needImage: Add an image to place zoom points.
admin.editorLabel: Picture of the card. Click to place a point, arrow keys to move the selected one.
admin.editorHint: Click the picture to place a point (2 to 5). Drag a circle to move it; the dashed square shows the widest view.
admin.eyesHint: Click one eye, then the other: the points of the face will be placed from them.
admin.savePoints: Save the points and cut the crops

detection.ok: One face found ({px} px between the eyes). The dashed green circles are proposals: click one to take it.
detection.none: No face found on this picture. Place the points by hand, or from the eyes.
detection.several: {n} faces found: the proposals are for the largest one. Check that it is the right one, or pick a picture of one person.
detection.small: Small face: {px} px between the eyes, {min} would be needed. The first close-up may be a blur; a larger picture would be better.
detection.unavailable: Face detection could not run. Place the points by hand, or from the eyes.

admin.aliasesHint: Separated by commas. For a person, add the family name on its own.
admin.creditHint: Shown on every reveal. Invent nothing: author and licence come from the source.
admin.deletePackConfirm: Delete this pack? This cannot be undone.

status.title: {appName} status
status.intro: Technical page: it proves the whole stack answers.
status.workerLatency: a job makes the round trip in {ms} ms
status.clock: Offset from the server clock: {offset} ms (round trip {rtt} ms)
